normalIntro.en: The same word covers the air around a planet and the air of a room.
normalIntro.cn: 同一个词既指行星周围的气层，也指一屋子里的空气。

normal.en: The ph in atmosphere sounds like f.
normal.cn: atmosphere 里的 ph 读作 f。

normal.en: For the gas layer, use the definite article: the atmosphere.
normal.cn: 指大气层时常加定冠词。

normal.en: For mood, use an article: a relaxed atmosphere.
normal.cn: 指气氛时用不定冠词：轻松的气氛。

normal.en: The adjective atmospheric also means full of mood.
normal.cn: 形容词 atmospheric 也可表示「很有氛围的」。

normal.en: The sphere part is the same as in hemisphere.
normal.cn: sphere 这一部分与 hemisphere 相同。

abstract.en: See a thin glowing skin around a blue ball.
abstract.cn: 想象蓝色球体外面一层发光的薄皮。

abstract.en: See a room where nobody speaks after a door shuts.
abstract.cn: 想象门关上后没人说话的屋子。

abstract.en: See breath visible in cold morning air.
abstract.cn: 想象寒冷清晨里可见的呼气。

examples.en: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere.
examples.cn: 二氧化碳把热量困在大气层里。

examples.en: The atmosphere in the room turned cold.
examples.cn: 屋里的气氛冷了下来。

examples.en: The café has a relaxed atmosphere.
examples.cn: 这家咖啡馆气氛轻松。

sensesIntro.en: Something invisible fills and surrounds, whether it is gas or feeling.

definition_zh: 维持；保养；供养；坚称；捍卫
definition_en: to keep something at the same level or in good condition, to support someone financially, or to state and defend a position
core_image: 一只手从下方托住重物，掌心始终不松，重物因此停在原处
scene: 长跑教练在赛道边提醒队员。 He told them to maintain this pace and not to chase the runners ahead, so that the whole group kept an even rhythm of breathing.
sceneCN: 这里 maintain 是「维持、保持」（第 1 个义项：把速度维持在原有水平）；句意：他让队员保持这个配速，不要去追前面的人，好让整队保持均匀的呼吸节奏。图中可辨识物件：跑道、配速表、队员队列、教练手势；对应第 1 个义项。

senses.title: Keep at a level: hold a state steady
senses.titleCN: 维持水平：让状态保持不坠
senses.definition: to keep something at a particular level, rate, or state over time
senses.definitionCN: 使某物在一段时间内保持在特定水平、速度或状态
senses.example: The pilot maintained a steady altitude through the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员在暴风雨中保持了稳定的高度。
senses.why: Latin manu tenere meant 'to hold with the hand'. The first sense is the plain physical image: a hand under a weight, neither lifting nor dropping it, so the level stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 manu tenere 意为“用手握住”。第一个义项就是最朴素的实体画面：一只手托着重物，既不举起也不放下，因此高度保持不变。

senses.title: Keep in good repair: service equipment
senses.definition: to keep a building, machine, or system in good working condition by regular checks and repairs
senses.definitionCN: 通过定期检查与修理，使建筑、机器或系统保持良好工作状态
senses.example: The crew maintains the bridge every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 养护队每年春天保养这座桥。
senses.why: A machine is held up by care: oil, parts, inspections. The hand now holds not a weight but a working order, and letting go means decay.
senses.whyCN: 机器靠照料才被“托住”：润滑油、零件、检查。手此时握住的不是重物，而是工作状态；一旦松手，就是衰败。

senses.title: Support financially: provide for someone
senses.definition: to provide money or resources for someone to live on
senses.definitionCN: 为某人提供生活所需的金钱或资源
senses.example: One salary was not enough to maintain a family of five.
senses.exampleCN: 一份工资不足以供养五口之家。
senses.why: To hold someone up can be economic: the hand supplies what keeps a household standing. The same verb that holds a level also holds people above poverty.
senses.whyCN: “托住某人”可以是经济上的：手提供让一个家庭站稳的东西。同一个表示“维持水平”的动词，也用来表示让人不至于陷入贫困。

senses.title: Assert as true: maintain that
senses.titleCN: 坚称：坚持认为某事为真
senses.definition: to state something firmly as true, especially when others doubt it
senses.definitionCN: 坚定地陈述某事为真，尤在他人怀疑时
senses.example: The company maintains that its product is safe.
senses.exampleCN: 公司坚称其产品是安全的。
senses.why: A claim is held the way a position is held: you keep it standing against pressure. The hand switches from supporting objects to supporting a proposition.
senses.whyCN: 一个主张被“握住”的方式，就像一个阵地被守住：你在压力下让它立着。手从托住物件转为托住一个命题。

senses.title: Defend a position: stand one's ground
senses.titleCN: 捍卫立场：守住自己的阵地
senses.definition: to defend or uphold an opinion, right, or position against opposition
senses.definitionCN: 面对反对仍捍卫或坚持某种意见、权利或立场
senses.example: She maintained her innocence throughout the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 整个审判期间她都坚持自己是无辜的。
senses.why: This is the military edge of the hand image: holding a line under attack. The assertion is not merely spoken but kept in place while others push against it.
senses.whyCN: 这是“手”的意象中带军事意味的一面：在攻击下守住一条线。主张不只是被说出，而是在别人推挤时仍被保持在原位。

senses.title: Keep records or accounts systematically
senses.titleCN: 维护记录：让账目持续完整
senses.definition: to keep records, accounts, or lists in an orderly and continuing way
senses.definitionCN: 以有序且持续的方式保存记录、账目或清单
senses.example: The lab maintains detailed logs of every experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室维护每次实验的详细日志。
senses.why: A record is a structure that collapses if nobody holds it: entries must be added, errors corrected, gaps filled. Maintaining is the regular hand that keeps the file from falling into disorder.
senses.whyCN: 记录是一种若无人托住就会塌的结构：要新增条目、修正错误、填补空缺。维护就是那只定期伸出的手，让档案不至于陷入混乱。

senses.title: Keep a system running: technical upkeep
senses.titleCN: 系统维护：让系统持续运行
senses.definition: to keep a network, website, or software system running and updated
senses.definitionCN: 使网络、网站或软件系统持续运行并及时更新
senses.example: Two engineers maintain the server around the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 两名工程师全天候维护服务器。
senses.why: Digital systems also fall if unsupported: patches, backups, monitoring. The verb extends from a physical machine to an invisible service that must be held online.
senses.whyCN: 数字系统若无人支持也会倒下：补丁、备份、监控。动词从实体机器延伸到必须被“托在线上”的无形服务。

senses.title: Keep health or weight stable
senses.definition: to keep one's body weight, health, or condition at a stable level
senses.definitionCN: 使体重、健康或身体状态保持在稳定水平
senses.example: He maintains his weight by walking to work.
senses.exampleCN: 他靠步行上班来保持体重。
senses.why: The body is the most intimate thing held steady. Maintaining weight is a daily counter-pressure against gain and loss, exactly the small continuous effort of the hand.
senses.whyCN: 身体是被维持得最切身的东西。保持体重，就是每天对增重与减重施加反向压力，正好对应那只手持续不断的小小用力。

senses.title: Usage boundary: formal upkeep, not mere keeping
senses.titleCN: 用法边界：正式的维护，不等于简单保留
senses.definition: a usage limit: maintain is more formal than keep, implies continuing effort, and maintain that is a formal way to report an assertion
senses.definitionCN: 用法限制：maintain 比 keep 正式，含持续付出的意味；maintain that 是转述某人主张的正式说法
senses.example: She keeps a spare key; the building manager maintains the locks.
senses.exampleCN: 她留着一把备用钥匙；物业经理负责维护门锁。
senses.why: Keeping can be passive possession; maintaining requires active care. The word also reports a claim without endorsing it, so a news report can say 'the minister maintains' while leaving the truth open.
senses.whyCN: keep 可以只是被动地保有；maintain 则要求主动照料。这个词还能在不背书的情况下转述主张，因此新闻报道可以写“部长坚称”，同时把真假留空。

intro.en: Maintain comes from Latin manu tenere 'to hold with the hand', through Old French maintenir. The hand-to-support chain is unusually clear; only the ultimate Indo-European root of tenere is less certain.
intro.cn: maintain 经由古法语 maintenir 来自拉丁语 manu tenere“用手握住”。从“手”到“维持”的引申链异常清楚；只有 tenere 最深的印欧词源较不确定。

items.en: Latin manus meant 'hand'. Its ablative form manu appears in phrases describing holding, seizing, and handing over.
items.cn: 拉丁语 manus 意为“手”。它的夺格形式 manu 出现在描述握住、抓取和交接的短语中。

items.en: Manu tenere meant literally 'to hold with the hand'. The phrase already implies keeping something from falling, which is the seed of every later sense.
items.cn: manu tenere 字面义就是“用手握住”。这个短语已经隐含“不让某物掉下去”，这正是后来所有义项的种子。

items.en: Old French maintenir meant 'to support, sustain, keep up; preserve'. French fused the Latin phrase into one verb and passed it to English.
items.cn: 古法语 maintenir 意为“支撑、维持、托住；保存”。法语把这个拉丁短语融合成一个动词，再传给英语。

items.en: English maintain is recorded in the 14c. with the senses 'to support, uphold, preserve' and soon also 'to assert, affirm'.
items.cn: 英语 maintain 在 14 世纪有记录，义为“支撑、维护、保存”，很快又出现“断言、坚称”义。

items.en: The chain runs from hand-hold to sustain, then to provide for, keep in repair, keep records, and finally hold a claim against doubt. Each step keeps the idea of not letting something fall.
items.cn: 引申链从“手持”到“支撑”，再到“供养”“保养”“维护记录”，最后到“在怀疑中守住一个主张”。每一步都保留“不让某物掉下去”的意思。

items.en: Modern English maintains bridges, servers, records, weight and arguments. Maintenance, with its shifted spelling, names the whole work of keeping things up.
items.cn: 现代英语 maintain 可以带桥梁、服务器、记录、体重和论点。拼写发生变化的 maintenance 则命名整套“让东西不倒”的工作。

note.en: The first group shares the maintain shape and the irregular noun maintenance; the second separates upkeep, endurance, protection, and assertion.
note.cn: 第一组共享 maintain 的词形与不规则名词 maintenance；第二组区分维护、持续支撑、保护和断言。

entries.definition: the work of keeping something in good condition, or the money needed to support it. Its spelling differs from maintain.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持良好状态的工作，或维持它所需的费用。它的拼写与 maintain 不同。

entries.definition: able to be kept up or defended. It is maintain plus -able.
entries.definitionCN: 可维持的；可维护的；可辩护的。它是 maintain 加 -able。

entries.definition: a person or thing that keeps something in working order. It is maintain plus -er.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持正常运转的人或物。它是 maintain 加 -er。

entries.definition: to continue to have or hold something in a particular state. It is more general and less formal than maintain.
entries.definitionCN: 继续保有某物或使其处于某种状态。它比 maintain 更一般、更不正式。

entries.definition: to keep something going over a long period, especially with resources or effort. It stresses endurance more than routine care.
entries.definitionCN: 在较长时期内让某物持续，尤指靠资源或努力。它比日常维护更强调持久承受。

entries.definition: to keep something in its original state and protect it from harm or decay. It focuses on preventing change.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持原状并防止受损或腐坏。它聚焦于阻止变化。

entries.definition: to state a fact or belief firmly. It overlaps maintain that, but carries no idea of upkeep.
entries.definitionCN: 坚定地陈述事实或信念。它与 maintain that 重叠，但不含“维护、保养”的意思。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Latin phrase manu tenere, the real collocations maintain order and maintain that, and the irregular noun maintenance.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：拉丁短语 manu tenere、真实搭配 maintain order 与 maintain that，以及不规则名词 maintenance。

normal.en: Manu tenere is 'to hold with the hand'; maintain is what a hand does when it refuses to let something drop.
normal.cn: manu tenere 就是“用手握住”；maintain 就是手不肯让东西掉下去时所做的动作。

normal.en: Maintain order means keeping a crowd or system from falling into disorder, one small correction at a time.
normal.cn: maintain order 指让一群人一个系统不陷入混乱，靠一次次小小的修正。

normal.en: Maintain equipment is routine care: oil, inspect, replace worn parts before they fail.
normal.cn: maintain equipment 是日常照料：上油、检查、在零件失效前更换。

normal.en: Maintain that ... reports a firm claim without saying whether the speaker agrees.
normal.cn: maintain that……转述一个坚定的主张，却不说明转述者是否同意。

normal.en: The noun is maintenance, not maintainance: the spelling shifted after the French noun.
normal.cn: 名词是 maintenance，不是 maintainance：拼写随法语名词发生了变化。

abstract.en: A hand under a falling object, applying just enough upward force to cancel gravity: maintain is continuous counter-pressure.
abstract.cn: 一只手托住下落的物体，施加刚好抵消重力的向上力：maintain 就是持续的反向压力。

abstract.en: A tightrope walker makes tiny corrections all the time; the walk looks still, but maintaining it is constant motion.
abstract.cn: 走钢丝的人一直在做微小修正；行走看似静止，维持它却是持续的运动。

abstract.en: A bridge is kept alive by paint nobody notices: maintenance is invisible until it stops.
abstract.cn: 一座桥靠没人注意的油漆活着：维护在停止之前都是看不见的。

examples.en: The team maintained its lead until the final minute.
examples.cn: 这支队伍把领先优势保持到最后一分钟。

examples.en: Regular checks maintain the machine far better than urgent repairs.
examples.cn: 定期检查保养机器，远胜于紧急抢修。

examples.en: The report maintains that the new policy has reduced waiting times.
examples.cn: 报告坚称新政策缩短了等待时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: “曼特恩”——曼特恩每天给机器上油，让它一直转下去 → maintain 维持、保养

root: 拉丁语 manu tenere“用手握住”＝manu（manus“手”的夺格）+ tenere“握持”；核心是“手不松开，东西就不倒”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of maintain, all from one hand: hold a level, service a machine, support a family, hold a claim, defend a line, keep records, keep a system online, keep the body steady, and finally the boundary between passive keeping and active upkeep.
sensesIntro.cn: maintain 的九个义项都出自同一只手：托住水平、保养机器、供养家庭、托住主张、守住防线、维护记录、让系统在线、让身体稳定，最后是“被动保有”与“主动维护”的边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand holds a weight from below and never lets go.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手从下方托住重物，始终不松开。

branches.en: LEVEL AND REPAIR: a hand keeps a height steady, or keeps a machine from decaying.
branches.cn: 水平与修缮：手让高度保持稳定，或让机器不至于衰败。

branches.en: PROVISION: holding someone up becomes paying for their living.
branches.cn: 供养：托住一个人变成支付他的生活所需。

branches.en: CLAIM AND DEFENCE: a proposition is held against doubt, and a position is held under attack.
branches.cn: 主张与辩护：在怀疑中托住一个命题，在攻击下守住一个立场。

branches.en: SYSTEMS: records and servers stay usable only while someone keeps holding them up.
branches.cn: 系统：记录与服务器只有在有人持续托住时才保持可用。

branches.en: BODY AND BOUNDARY: weight is kept steady, while maintain is distinguished from mere keeping by effort and formality.
branches.cn: 身体与边界：体重被保持稳定；同时 maintain 以“付出与正式度”区别于单纯的 keep。

intro.en: Maintain is a French verb that came from a Latin phrase, not a prefixed English word. English adds -ance, -able, -er and -ed; the noun maintenance shows a spelling shift.
intro.cn: maintain 是从拉丁短语来的法语动词，不是带前缀的英语词。英语加 -ance、-able、-er、-ed；名词 maintenance 显示了拼写变化。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on manus 'hand': manual, manuscript, manufacture and manumit all describe work, writing, making, or releasing by hand.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 manus“手”上：manual、manuscript、manufacture、manumit 都描述用手操作、书写、制造或释放。

items.meaning: the work of keeping something in good condition; the cost of support
items.meaningCN: 保养；维护；维持费用（-ance 构成行为或状态名词，拼写有变化）
items.exampleCN: 这栋建筑需要定期维护。

items.meaning: able to be kept up or defended
items.meaningCN: 可维持的；可维护的；可辩护的（-able 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: The software is designed to be easily maintainable.
items.exampleCN: 这款软件的设计目标是易于维护。

items.meaning: a person or thing that keeps something in working order
items.meaningCN: 维持者；维护者（-er 表示执行该动作的人或物）
items.example: The maintainer of the archive checks it every month.
items.exampleCN: 档案的维护者每月检查一次。

items.meaningCN: 保养良好的；维持住的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.exampleCN: 这座花园维护得很漂亮。

items.example: The hand is the image behind maintain and manual.
items.exampleCN: “手”是 maintain 与 manual 背后的意象。

items.example: The verb supplies the holding that maintain describes.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供 maintain 所描述的“握住”。

items.example: French passed this hand form into English maintain.
items.exampleCN: 法语把这个“手”的形式传给了英语的 maintain。

items.example: The same ending appears in retain, contain and sustain.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾见于 retain、contain 与 sustain。

items.structure: Latin tenens, present participle of tenere
items.meaning: one who holds land of another
items.example: The tenant holds the land without owning it.
items.exampleCN: 承租人持有土地但并不拥有它。

items.example: The museum retains the original frame.
items.exampleCN: 博物馆保留了原来的画框。

latinEntries.meaning: done with the hands; a handbook

latinEntries.meaningCN: 手稿；手写文稿（“用手写成的”）

latinEntries.meaning: to make goods, originally by hand
latinEntries.meaningCN: 制造；生产（原义“用手做成”）

latinEntries.meaning: to release a slave from ownership
latinEntries.meaningCN: 解放（奴隶）；原义“从手中放走”

definition_en: to give someone facts or knowledge, or to tell an authority about a crime or wrongdoing
core_image: 把消息递到对方手里：让对方从不知道变为知道
scene: 办公室里，助理拿着刚打印的通知快步走向经理的桌子。 Please inform the manager that the meeting has been moved to tomorrow morning.
sceneCN: 这里 inform 是「通知」（第 1 个义项：把事实或消息告诉某人）；句意：请通知经理会议已改到明早。

collocations.zh: 消息灵通的；见多识广的

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「信息；情报」
由动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「提供信息的；有益的」
由动词加施动者后缀构成，义为「告密者；线人」
由形容词义加否定前缀构成，义为「非正式的」
由过去分词加副词构成，义为「见识广的」

senses.title: To give someone facts or news
senses.definition: to tell someone about something, giving them facts they did not have
senses.definitionCN: 把对方原本不知道的事实或消息告诉某人
senses.example: Please inform me of any changes to the schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 日程如有变动请通知我。
senses.why: The Latin root means to give shape to, and giving facts shapes what a person knows.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根本义是「赋予形状」，把事实交给别人，正是在塑造对方的认知。

senses.title: To shape or guide something such as a decision
senses.definition: to have a strong effect on ideas, decisions, or attitudes
senses.definitionCN: 强烈影响思想、决定或态度
senses.example: Her rural childhood informed every novel she wrote.
senses.exampleCN: 她在乡下的童年影响了她写的每一部小说。
senses.why: From shaping knowledge it is a short step to shaping judgment and creative work.
senses.whyCN: 从「塑造认知」到「塑造判断与创作」，只有一步之遥。

senses.title: To tell an authority about wrongdoing
senses.definition: to tell the police or another authority that someone has done something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 向警方或有关部门举报他人的违法行为
senses.example: Someone informed against the smugglers at the port.
senses.exampleCN: 有人告发了港口的走私者。
senses.why: Informing an authority is informing in the official direction: facts flow upward to power.
senses.whyCN: 向官方通报，是把事实向上递交给权力，属同一动作的官方走向。

intro.en: Inform comes from a Latin verb meaning to give form or shape to something.
intro.cn: inform 源自一个拉丁动词，本义是「赋予形式」。

items.en: Latin informare meant to give form to, to shape, built on forma (shape, figure).
items.cn: 拉丁语 informare 意为「赋形、塑造」，建立在 forma（形状）之上。

items.en: In late Latin the verb also came to mean to instruct and train the mind.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语中该动词又引申为教导、训练心智。

items.en: Old French adopted it as enfourmer and informer with both shaping and teaching senses.
items.cn: 古法语借入为 enfourmer 与 informer，兼具塑造与教导两义。

items.en: English took the word in the fourteenth century, first about shaping the mind with teaching.
items.cn: 英语于十四世纪引入，最初指以教导塑造心智。

items.en: The senses narrowed to giving facts and news, with the report-a-crime sense appearing by the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 词义收窄为提供事实与消息，举报义至十六世纪前后出现。

note.en: Watch the shape-root family and the close reporting words.
note.cn: 注意「形状」词根家族与相近的举报类词。

entries.definition: facts and knowledge that are communicated
entries.definitionCN: 信息；由 inform 直接派生的名词

entries.definition: a person who reports others to the authorities
entries.definitionCN: 告密者；线人

entries.definition: to spoil the shape of something
entries.definitionCN: 使变形；同源于拉丁 forma（形状）

entries.definition: to officially tell someone about something
entries.definitionCN: （正式地）通知；告知

entries.definition: to give information in speech
entries.definitionCN: 告诉；日常用词

entries.definition: to hand over information disloyally
entries.definitionCN: 出卖；背叛，带贬义的告知

normalIntro.en: Five links built from the real root and word family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词根与词族的联想。

normal.en: in- (into) + form (shape): press facts into someone's mind like molding clay.
normal.cn: in-（进入）+ form（形状）：像捏陶一样把事实按进对方脑中。

normal.en: Same root as formal, format, formula: all about shape and pattern.
normal.cn: 与 formal、format、formula 同根：都与形状与模式有关。

normal.en: The noun information is simply the act of informing turned into a thing.
normal.cn: 名词 information 就是把「告知」这一动作变成名词。

normal.en: An informer is one who informs the police.
normal.cn: informer 即向警方告发的人。

normal.en: Collocation habit: inform someone OF something.
normal.cn: 搭配习惯：inform someone OF something。

abstract.en: A courier handing a sealed letter across a desk.
abstract.cn: 信使隔着办公桌递上一封封好口的信。

abstract.en: A sculptor's hands pressing a lump of clay into shape.
abstract.cn: 雕塑家的双手把一团泥捏出形状。

abstract.en: A courtroom where facts are laid out one by one.
abstract.cn: 法庭上，事实被逐条摆明。

examples.en: The school will inform parents about the new timetable by email.
examples.cn: 学校将用电子邮件把新课程表通知家长。

examples.en: Research findings should inform government policy.
examples.cn: 研究成果应能为政府决策提供依据。

examples.en: He was arrested after a neighbor informed on him.
examples.cn: 邻居告发后，他被逮捕了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「音服母」——把消息像录音一样放进对方耳朵，连妈妈都会被说服。

root: 拉丁语 informare（赋形、塑造），由前缀 in-（进入；赋予）与名词 forma（形状）构成；「把形状赋予心智」引申为「告知、教导」。

sensesIntro.en: From shaping the mind with facts, the word spreads to guiding decisions and reporting crimes.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「用事实塑造心智」出发，词义扩展到左右决策与举报罪行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: giving shape to what someone knows
core.cn: 核心意象：为对方已知的东西赋予形状

branches.en: the everyday act of passing facts
branches.cn: 日常的传递事实行为

branches.en: facts quietly steering judgments and art
branches.cn: 事实暗中左右判断与创作

branches.en: facts handed upward to authority
branches.cn: 事实向上递交给权威

branches.en: both senses move knowledge from one mind to another
branches.cn: 两个义项都是让知识从一颗心进入另一颗心

branches.en: informing power and informing thought share one channel
branches.cn: 告知权力与启迪思想共用同一条通道

intro.en: Inform belongs to the large family built on Latin forma.
intro.cn: inform 属于拉丁语 forma 构成的大家族。

latinIntro.en: The shape root forma generates a network of English words about form and instruction.
latinIntro.cn: 形状词根 forma 生成了关于形式与教导的英语词网络。

items.meaning: to give form to; to shape
items.example: informare shaped both inform and informer
items.exampleCN: informare 塑造了 inform 与 informer
提供信息的；有创造力的

items.meaning: to shape oneself to a pattern

definition_en: a simple drawing that shows the parts of something or how it works
core_image: 黑板上几个方框和箭头，把机器的内部讲清楚
scene: 老师在黑板上画了几个方框和箭头，把水流的方向标出来。 The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
sceneCN: 这里 diagram 指「示意图」（第 1 个义项：用简单线条说明结构的图）；句意是这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。

derivatives.zh: 图解的；图示的
用图的方式
用图标出的
图示过程

senses.title: A simple explanatory drawing
senses.definition: a simple drawing that shows the parts of something and how they fit
senses.definitionCN: 用简单线条画出某物的各部分及其组合关系
senses.example: The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
senses.exampleCN: 这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。
senses.why: A picture of the parts removes the need for a hundred words.
senses.whyCN: 一张画清零件的图，省掉了一百句话。

senses.title: A chart of steps or numbers
senses.definition: a drawing that sets out numbers, steps or relations in visual form
senses.definitionCN: 把数字、步骤或关系用视觉形式摆出来的图
senses.example: The diagram on page ten compares the two methods.
senses.exampleCN: 第十页上的图表比较了这两种方法。
senses.why: Once the steps are drawn, the eye can walk them.
senses.whyCN: 步骤一旦被画出来，眼睛就能在上面走。

senses.title: Show something by drawing
senses.definition: to represent something with a simple drawing
senses.definitionCN: 用简单的图把某事物表示出来
senses.example: He diagrammed the route on the back of an envelope.
senses.exampleCN: 他在信封背面把路线画了出来。
senses.why: When speech fails, the hand reaches for a pen.
senses.whyCN: 说不清的时候，手就去拿笔。

intro.en: Diagram comes from Greek diagramma, something marked out by lines, built from dia- and graphein, to write or draw.
intro.cn: diagram 来自希腊语 diagramma（用线标出来的东西），由 dia- 与 graphein（写、画）构成。

items.en: Graphein meant to scratch or draw, and diagramma meant a figure marked out.
items.cn: graphein 指刻画，diagramma 指被线条标出的图形。

items.en: Geometers used it for the figure drawn beside a proof.
items.cn: 几何学家用它指证明旁边画出的那个图形。

items.en: Latin diagramma kept the mathematical sense of a drawn figure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diagramma 保留了画出图形的数学义。

items.en: English diagram named a figure used to explain a text.
items.cn: 英语 diagram 指用来解释文字的图形。

items.en: It now covers circuit plans, flow charts and simple sketches.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖电路图、流程图以及简单草图。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dia- opening, while the meaning group names other visual aids.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dia- 开头，近义组则指其他几种视觉工具。

entries.definition: to identify an illness or fault
entries.definitionCN: 判断出疾病或故障

entries.definition: a line across a circle through its centre
entries.definitionCN: 穿过圆心横跨圆的一条线

entries.definition: a form of a language spoken in one area
entries.definitionCN: 某一地区所说的一种语言形式

entries.definition: a drawing that shows information
entries.definitionCN: 展示信息的图

entries.definition: a drawing of values on axes
entries.definitionCN: 在坐标轴上画出数值的图

entries.definition: a quick rough drawing
entries.definitionCN: 快速的粗略画稿

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with chalk boxes on a blackboard and end with a route drawn on an envelope.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑板上的粉笔方框开始，落到画在信封上的路线。

normal.en: Dia- is through, and a diagram draws a line through a complicated thing.
normal.cn: dia- 是穿过，diagram 就是在一个复杂东西上画穿一条线。

normal.en: Boxes and arrows are a sentence the eye can read at once.
normal.cn: 方框与箭头，是一句眼睛一眼就能读完的话。

normal.en: A good diagram leaves out more than it shows.
normal.cn: 好的示意图，省掉的东西比画出来的多。

normal.en: The circuit and the river use the same little arrows.
normal.cn: 电路与河流，用的是同样的小箭头。

normal.en: When words get heavy, draw the shape.
normal.cn: 话变重的时候，就把形状画出来。

abstract.en: Picture three chalk squares joined by one line.
abstract.cn: 想象三个粉笔方框被一条线连起来。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow pointing down a narrow pipe.
abstract.cn: 想象一个箭头沿着一根细管向下指。

abstract.en: Picture a pen making a quick turn on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在纸上快速拐了个弯。

examples.en: The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
examples.cn: 这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。

examples.en: The diagram on page ten compares the two methods.
examples.cn: 第十页上的图表比较了这两种方法。

examples.en: He diagrammed the route on the back of an envelope.
examples.cn: 他在信封背面把路线画了出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diagram 记成「带个弯」：dia 是穿过，gram 是写下的东西，用线穿过复杂处写下来，就是示意图。

root: 来自希腊语 diagramma，由 dia-（穿过）与 graphein（刻画）组成，本义是用线标出的图形。经拉丁语进入英语，最初用于几何证明旁画的图，后来泛指解释结构、步骤与数据的各种图示。

sensesIntro.en: From a figure drawn beside a proof, to a chart of steps, to a quick sketch on an envelope.
sensesIntro.cn: 从证明旁边画出的图形，到步骤图表，再到信封上的快速草图。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a few boxes and arrows explaining a hidden mechanism.
core.cn: 核心意象：几个方框和箭头，把藏在里面的机关讲明白。

branches.en: The first sense is the parts laid out in space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把各部分在空间里摆开。

branches.en: The second sense puts steps and numbers in place of parts.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用步骤和数字替换了零件。

branches.en: The third sense is the act of drawing it at all.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把它画出来这个动作本身。

branches.en: A machine and a set of figures are both made readable by lines.
branches.cn: 机器与一串数字，都靠线条变得可读。

branches.en: The chart and the quick sketch differ only in care.
branches.cn: 图表与速写，只差在精细程度。

intro.en: Diagram has a family built on drawing and on lines that mark a shape.
intro.cn: diagram 有一族词，建在「画」与「用线标出形状」之上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base graphein means to draw or write, and dia- adds the sense of marking across.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基 graphein 意为画或写，前缀 dia- 添上横着标出的意思。

items.example: The diagram is easy to follow.
items.exampleCN: 这张示意图很容易看懂。
这本书有清楚的示意图。

items.meaning: the act of drawing a figure
items.example: Diagramming the flow took an hour.
items.exampleCN: 把流程画成图花了一小时。

items.meaning: in the form of a diagram

这些部件以图解方式呈现。

definition_zh: 木乃伊；干尸；（英式儿语）妈妈
definition_en: a dead body preserved by embalming or by natural drying, especially one from ancient Egypt
core_image: 一具被布条层层缠住的遗体，皮肤干成皮革，眼睛的位置只剩两个深窝
scene: 展柜里的遗体被布条层层缠住，皮肤干成深褐色，标签写着出土地点。 The mummy lay in the case, wrapped in layer upon layer of linen, its skin dried to a dark brown.
sceneCN: 这里 mummy 指「经防腐或自然干燥而保存下来的遗体」（第 1 个义项：人工或自然形成的干尸）；句意为展柜里一具木乃伊被层层亚麻布包裹，皮肤干成深褐色。可辨识物件：亚麻布、展柜、干枯的手。

pos.zh: 木乃伊；干尸；（英式儿语）妈妈

derivatives.zh: mummy（木乃伊）+ -fy（拉丁 -ficare，使成为）→ 使成木乃伊；干尸化
mummify（使成木乃伊）+ -ation（拉丁 -atio，过程名词）→ 木乃伊化；干尸制作
mummify（使成木乃伊）+ -ed（已完成的）→ 已成干尸的
mummy（木乃伊）+ case（箱匣）→ 木乃伊棺匣
mummy（木乃伊）+ cloth（布）→ 木乃伊裹布
mummy（木乃伊）+ brown（棕色）→ 木乃伊棕（颜料）
mummy（木乃伊）+ portrait（肖像）→ 木乃伊肖像

senses.title: An embalmed body
senses.definition: a dead body preserved by embalming so that it does not decay
senses.definitionCN: 经防腐处理、因而不腐坏的遗体
senses.example: The mummy was wrapped in linen and laid in a painted case.
senses.exampleCN: 这具木乃伊用亚麻布包裹，安放在彩绘棺匣里。
senses.why: The word first named a medicinal substance from embalmed bodies, then the bodies themselves.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指从防腐尸体中取得的一种药，随后才指尸体本身。

senses.title: An Egyptian mummy
senses.definition: a body preserved by the Egyptian embalming tradition
senses.definitionCN: 按埃及防腐传统保存下来的遗体
senses.example: The Egyptian mummy was scanned without opening its wrappings.
senses.exampleCN: 这具埃及木乃伊未拆裹布就做了扫描。
senses.why: Egyptian examples were so famous that the word became almost a proper label for them.
senses.whyCN: 埃及的实例过于著名，这个词几乎成了它们的专称。

senses.title: A naturally dried body
senses.definition: a body dried by sand, wind or cold before decay could proceed
senses.definitionCN: 在腐坏开始前被沙、风或寒冷干燥保存的遗体
senses.example: The desert mummy was preserved by dry air rather than by resin.
senses.exampleCN: 这具沙漠干尸靠干燥空气而非树脂保存下来。
senses.why: Once the body, not the method, defines the word, natural drying also counts.
senses.whyCN: 一旦定义这个词的是遗体而非处理方法，自然干燥也算在内。

senses.title: An animal mummy
senses.definition: a preserved animal body, often a sacred or companion animal
senses.definitionCN: 被保存下来的动物遗体，常为圣兽或陪伴动物
senses.example: Cat mummies were sold as offerings in the temple courts.
senses.exampleCN: 猫木乃伊在神庙庭院里作为供品出售。
senses.why: The practice extended to animals, and the word followed without a separate term.
senses.whyCN: 这种做法扩展到动物，词也随之延伸，并未另造新词。

senses.title: Mother, in British nursery speech
senses.definition: a child's word for mother, from a different nursery syllable
senses.definitionCN: 儿童对母亲的称呼，来自另一个儿语词
senses.example: The child ran to her mummy at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子跑向门口的妈妈。
senses.why: This homonym comes from the nursery word mum, not from Arabic mumiya, and the two histories never touch.
senses.whyCN: 这个同形词来自儿语词 mum，而非阿拉伯语 mumiya，两条来历从未交汇。

senses.title: The bitumen drug of the old name
senses.definition: the medicinal substance formerly prepared from embalmed bodies or from bitumen
senses.definitionCN: 旧时取自防腐尸体或沥青的药用物质
senses.example: Apothecaries sold mummy as a cure for bruises.
senses.exampleCN: 旧时药剂师把木乃伊药当作治跌打的药出售。
senses.why: Arabic mumiya named bitumen, and the drug sense came before the body sense in English.
senses.whyCN: 阿拉伯语 mumiya 指沥青，英语中「药」义先于「遗体」义出现。

senses.title: A dried-out, gaunt person
senses.definition: a living person who looks dried out and stiff
senses.definitionCN: 看起来干枯僵硬的活人
senses.example: He came back from the desert a mummy of his former self.
senses.exampleCN: 他从沙漠回来，成了昔日自己的干尸。
senses.why: The metaphor uses the mummy's dryness and stiffness, not its death.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻取的是木乃伊的干与僵，而非它的死亡。

senses.title: Mummy brown pigment
senses.definition: a brown pigment formerly made from ground mummy remains
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用研磨的木乃伊遗骸制成的棕色颜料
senses.example: Mummy brown was used for shadows until supplies ran out.
senses.exampleCN: 木乃伊棕曾被用来画阴影，直到原料耗尽。
senses.why: The pigment trade named the colour after its source, and the colour outlived the practice.
senses.whyCN: 颜料贸易以原料给颜色命名，而颜色比这种做法活得更久。

intro.en: Mummy began as the name of bitumen and a medicine, then shifted to the embalmed bodies that supplied it; English also has a separate nursery word mummy for mother. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: mummy 先是沥青与一种药的名称，后转到提供这种药的防腐尸体上；英语另有一个指母亲的儿语同形词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Persian mum meant 'wax', and the word passed into Arabic as the name of a bituminous substance.
items.cn: 波斯语 mum 意为「蜡」，这个词进入阿拉伯语后指一种沥青状物质。

items.en: Arabic mumiya named bitumen, especially the pitch used in embalming, and also the preserved body that contained it.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 mumiya 指沥青，尤指防腐所用的沥青，也指含有沥青的保存遗体。

items.en: Medieval Latin mumia and Old French momie carried the word to Europe as a drug made from ground mummy.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁 mumia 与古法语 momie 把这个词带到欧洲，指用研磨木乃伊制成的药。

items.en: By the seventeenth century English mummy meant the embalmed body itself, and Egypt became its most famous source.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，英语 mummy 已指防腐遗体本身，埃及则成为最著名的来源地。

items.en: The nursery word mummy for mother comes from mum, a reduplicated infant sound, and is unrelated to the Arabic word.
items.cn: 指母亲的儿语 mummy 来自 mum，即婴儿重复的音节，与阿拉伯语词无关。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): why mummified flesh was called a wax word is not established, and the earliest English use of the body sense has no exact citation, so any earlier date offered is provisional.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：为何把防腐遗体用「蜡」词称呼，尚无定论；英语中遗体义的最早使用没有确切书证，凡给出的更早年代都是暂定的。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like mummy but belong to other roots; group two holds other ways of naming a preserved body.
note.cn: 第一组是与 mummy 形近却另有词源的词；第二组是其他指保存遗体的说法。

entries.definition: The short nursery word for mother; mummy is its diminutive, unrelated to the Arabic burial word.
entries.definitionCN: 指母亲的儿语短词；mummy 是它的指小形式，与阿拉伯语埋葬词无关。

entries.definition: From Middle English momelen 'to speak indistinctly', probably imitative of closed lips.
entries.definitionCN: 来自中古英语 momelen「含糊地说」，大概模仿闭唇的声音。

entries.definition: From Old French momerie 'masking, buffoonery', with a different origin and meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 来自古法语 momerie「戴面具、滑稽表演」，来源与含义都不同。

entries.definition: From Russian mamont, a name for a large extinct elephant; it looks like mummy but shares nothing.
entries.definitionCN: 来自俄语 mamont，指已灭绝的大型象；看似与 mummy 相近，实则毫无关联。

entries.definition: The neutral word for a dead body, with no suggestion of preservation.
entries.definitionCN: 指遗体的中性词，不含保存之意。

entries.definition: A formal or medical word for a dead body, from Latin cadere 'to fall'.
entries.definitionCN: 正式或医学用语，来自拉丁 cadere「倒下」。

entries.definition: A body preserved by injecting or coating with preservatives, whether or not wrapped.
entries.definitionCN: 经注射或涂覆防腐剂保存的遗体，不论是否裹布。

entries.definition: The remains or belongings of a holy person, kept for veneration.
entries.definitionCN: 受尊崇者的遗骸或遗物，供人敬奉。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Arabic bitumen word, the linen wrappings and the unrelated mother word.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：阿拉伯语的沥青词、亚麻裹布，以及毫无关联的「妈妈」词。

normal.en: Arabic mumiya 'bitumen' is the source of the burial word.
normal.cn: 阿拉伯语 mumiya「沥青」是埋葬义的来源。

normal.en: The drug sense came before the body sense in English.
normal.cn: 英语中药义先于遗体义出现。

normal.en: Mummy for mother comes from mum, a nursery sound, and is unrelated.
normal.cn: 指母亲的 mummy 来自儿语 mum，与前者无关。

normal.en: Real compounds: mummy case, mummy cloth, mummy brown.
normal.cn: 真实复合词：木乃伊棺匣、木乃伊裹布、木乃伊棕。

normal.en: The plural is mummies, never mummys.
normal.cn: 复数作 mummies，不写作 mummys。

abstract.en: Picture a body wrapped so tightly that the person becomes a package.
abstract.cn: 想象一具被裹得极紧的遗体，人变成了一个包裹。

abstract.en: Picture a face dried to leather, with the eyes reduced to two hollows.
abstract.cn: 想象一张干成皮革的脸，眼睛只剩两个深窝。

abstract.en: Picture a jar of dark medicine ground from something nobody now wishes to name.
abstract.cn: 想象一罐深色药粉，研磨自如今没人愿意点名的东西。

examples.en: The museum scanned the mummy without removing the wrappings.
examples.cn: 博物馆未拆裹布就对木乃伊做了扫描。

examples.en: Animal mummies were kept in jars as temple offerings.
examples.cn: 动物木乃伊被装在罐中作为神庙供品。

examples.en: The paint was mixed with mummy brown, a pigment no longer made.
examples.cn: 这颜料掺了木乃伊棕，一种如今不再生产的颜料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「mummy」听似「妈咪」——裹得紧紧、像被妈妈抱住的干尸 → 木乃伊

root: 阿拉伯语 mumiya「沥青」（源自波斯语 mum「蜡」），经中世纪拉丁 mumia、古法语 momie 入英语；先指药，后指防腐遗体。指母亲的 mummy 来自儿语 mum，同形异源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start from the embalmed body and its Egyptian and natural varieties, add animal mummies, then the unrelated mother word, the old bitumen drug, the gaunt-person metaphor and the pigment trade.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从防腐遗体出发，涵盖埃及与自然形成的类型，加入动物木乃伊，再转向无关的「妈妈」词、旧的沥青药、干瘪者的比喻与颜料贸易。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body wrapped into a package, dried until the face becomes leather and hollows.
core.cn: 核心意象：一具被裹成包裹的遗体，干到脸成皮革、只剩眼窝。

branches.en: EMBALMED BODY: the drug word settles on the bodies that supplied it, above all Egyptian ones.
branches.cn: 防腐遗体：「药」词落到提供药的遗体上，尤以埃及者为代表。

branches.en: DRYING WITHOUT RESIN: natural drying and animal burials widen the word beyond embalming.
branches.cn: 不用树脂的干燥：自然干尸与动物墓葬把词扩展到防腐之外。

branches.en: MOTHER HOMONYM: the nursery word shares spelling only.
branches.cn: 「妈妈」同形词：儿语词只共享拼写。

branches.en: MATERIAL TRADE: bitumen as medicine and ground remains as pigment both name a substance.
branches.cn: 材料贸易：沥青作药、遗骸研磨作颜料，命名的都是物质。

branches.en: DRY PERSON: the metaphor keeps dryness and stiffness, not death.
branches.cn: 干枯的人：比喻取干燥与僵硬，而非死亡。

intro.en: Mummy is a borrowed Arabic word, and its English family is built with Latin and Greek suffixes for making and processing.

definition_en: inside, toward the center, or private and personal in the mind
core_image: 由外向内走：一层层进入中心
scene: 老宅的木门后还有一道厚重的内门，推开后是安静的庭院。 She opened the inner door and stepped into the quiet courtyard.
sceneCN: 这里 inner 是「里面的」（第 1 个义项：靠内的、更接近中心的）；句意：她推开内门，走进安静的庭院。

senses.title: Located inside, closer to the center
senses.definition: situated inside or nearer to the middle of something

senses.example: The inner ring of the stadium filled first.
senses.exampleCN: 体育场的内圈最先坐满。
senses.why: Inner is literally the comparative of in: more toward the inside.
senses.whyCN: inner 本义就是 in 的比较级：更靠里。

senses.title: Private and mental, not shown outside
senses.definition: belonging to the mind or spirit, not expressed outwardly
senses.definitionCN: 属于心灵或精神的，不外露的
senses.example: Meditation helped her find inner calm.
senses.exampleCN: 冥想帮助她找到内心的平静。
senses.why: The space metaphor moves inward from rooms to the mind.
senses.whyCN: 空间隐喻由房间向内推进到心灵。

senses.title: Of the inner part of a city
senses.definition: relating to the central area of a city
senses.definitionCN: 与城市中心区域相关的
senses.example: Inner city schools need more funding.
senses.exampleCN: 内城学校需要更多经费。
senses.why: Urban geography borrows the center image for the middle rings of a city.
senses.whyCN: 城市地理借用「中心」意象指称城市的中间环带。

intro.en: Inner is simply the old comparative of the adverb in.
intro.cn: inner 本是副词 in 的古老比较级。

items.en: Old English had inra and innerra as comparatives of inne (within).
items.cn: 古英语以 inra、innerra 作 inne（在内）的比较级。

items.en: Middle English fixed inner as the standing form, replacing most rivals.
items.cn: 中古英语固定了 inner 这一形式，取代多数竞争形式。

items.en: The mental sense grew as writers pictured the mind as an inward space.
items.cn: 随作家把心灵描绘为内向空间，「内心」义逐渐生长。

items.en: Urban life added the inner city sense in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪城市生活催生了 inner city 的用法。

items.en: Self-help and psychology keep the inner-life senses central today.
items.cn: 如今心理学与自助话语使「内心生活」诸义保持核心地位。

note.en: The family all point inward; near-words slice space differently.
note.cn: 词族皆指向内；近义词切分空间的方式不同。

definition_en: a mark left on skin or feelings after a wound has healed
core_image: 手臂上一道淡白色的旧疤，记录着多年前的一次事故

senses.title: Mark on skin
senses.definition: a mark left on the skin after a wound has healed
senses.definitionCN: 伤口愈合后留在皮肤上的痕迹
senses.example: The cut left a small scar on her knee.
senses.exampleCN: 那道割伤在她膝盖上留下了一个小疤。
senses.why: The core sense is the visible trace of healing.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是愈合留下的可见痕迹。

senses.title: Emotional wound
senses.definition: a lasting emotional hurt caused by a bad experience
senses.definitionCN: 糟糕经历造成的持久情感伤害
senses.example: The loss left deep scars on the family.
senses.exampleCN: 这次失去给这个家庭留下了深深的创伤。
senses.why: A mark on the mind mirrors a mark on the skin.
senses.whyCN: 心灵上的印记与皮肤上的印记相呼应。

senses.title: Leave a mark
senses.definition: to mark or damage someone or something permanently
senses.definitionCN: 永久地在某人或某物上留下痕迹或伤害
senses.example: The accident scarred him for life.
senses.exampleCN: 那场事故给他留下了终生的创伤。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb for causing the mark.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示造成痕迹的动词。

definition_zh: 做广告；宣传；登广告招聘；登广告征求；公开宣扬；使引人注意
definition_en: to make a product, service, or job known to the public, to ask for something by placing a notice, or to make something conspicuous
core_image: 一块牌子被举到人群头顶上，四周的人都抬起了头
scene: 街角面包店的玻璃上贴出一张手写纸条，说是缺一个帮手。 The bakery advertised for an assistant in its window.
sceneCN: 这里 advertise 指登广告招人（第 2 个义项：登广告招聘）；句意为面包店在橱窗里登广告招一名帮手。

pos.zh: 动词：做广告；宣传；登广告招聘；登广告征求；使引人注意

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「广告」
由本词加表示施动者的后缀 -er 构成，义为「广告主；登广告的人」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「广告业；广告活动」

senses.title: To promote goods or services publicly
senses.definition: to tell the public about a product, service, or event, usually by paying for space or time in the media
senses.definitionCN: 向公众介绍商品、服务或活动，通常通过付费购买媒体版面或时段
senses.example: The company advertised its new phone on television.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在电视上为新手机会做广告。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to turn someone toward something, and a paid advertisement is an organised way of turning a whole audience toward a product.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词意为把某人转向某物，而付费广告就是有组织地把整群观众转向一件商品。

senses.title: To announce a job vacancy
senses.definition: to make a job known publicly so that people can apply for it
senses.definitionCN: 公开告知某个职位空缺，以便人们前来应聘
senses.example: The bakery advertised for an assistant in its window.
senses.exampleCN: 面包店在橱窗里登广告招一名帮手。
senses.why: A vacancy is made public in the same way as a product: a notice turns the attention of anyone who might want it.
senses.whyCN: 职位空缺和商品一样被推到公众面前：一张告示把可能想来应征的人的注意力转过来。

senses.title: To ask for something by notice
senses.definition: to place a notice asking for something you want, such as a flat, a worker, or a lost item
senses.definitionCN: 刊登告示，寻求自己想要的东西，如房子、人手或失物
senses.example: They advertised for a lodger in the free paper.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在免费报纸上登广告找房客。
senses.why: Here the sign is turned toward the public with a question rather than an offer, but the mechanism is the same raised notice.
senses.whyCN: 这里的牌子带的是问题而不是推销，但机制相同：把告示举到公众面前。

senses.title: To make your own affairs public
senses.definition: to make something about yourself widely known, often in a way that draws unwanted judgement
senses.definitionCN: 把自己某方面的事广泛告知他人，常带有招来非议的意味
senses.example: He advertised his ignorance by arguing with the referee.
senses.exampleCN: 他跟裁判争执，等于公开宣扬自己的无知。
senses.why: The word can expose as well as sell: whatever is turned toward the crowd becomes public, including a fault you meant to hide.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既能推销也能暴露：凡是被转向人群的东西都会变公开，包括你本想藏起来的缺点。

senses.title: To make something stand out
senses.definition: of a feature, colour, or mark, to make something easily noticed, especially in formal or literary use
senses.definitionCN: 指某个特征、颜色或标记使事物容易被注意到，多用于正式或文学语体
senses.example: A bright red door advertised the little shop from the end of the street.
senses.exampleCN: 一扇鲜红的门从街尾就让人注意到这家小店。
senses.why: Anything conspicuous is, in the old sense, advertising itself: it turns the eye without paying for the attention.
senses.whyCN: 任何显眼的东西都在「老意义」上自我宣传：它不花钱就把目光转了过来。

senses.title: To be presented as something
senses.definition: in the pattern be advertised as, to be described in a particular way in order to attract people
senses.definitionCN: 用于 be advertised as 结构，指为了吸引人而以某种方式描述某事
senses.example: The event was advertised as a family day.
senses.exampleCN: 这场活动被宣传为家庭日。
senses.why: A notice does not only say what a thing is; it chooses a frame for it, and that chosen frame is what the public is turned toward.
senses.whyCN: 告示不只是说明事物是什么，还为它挑好一个框；公众被转向的正是这个挑好的框。

intro.en: Advertise began as a Latin verb about turning attention; its modern commercial sense is a later English development.
intro.cn: advertise 最初是一个表示「转动注意力」的拉丁动词；现代的商业义是英语后来发展出来的。

items.en: Ad 'to, toward' plus vertere 'to turn' formed advertere, 'to turn toward'.
items.cn: ad「朝向」加 vertere「转」构成 advertere，意为「使转向」。

items.en: The verb also took the sense 'to turn the mind to, notice, pay attention', which passed into French and English.
items.cn: 这个动词还发展出「把心思转向、注意到、留意」的意思，并传入法语和英语。

items.en: English recorded advertise in the fifteenth century meaning 'to turn one's attention' and 'to inform, give notice'.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪记录到 advertise，义为「把注意力转向」以及「告知、通知」。

items.en: The sense moved from informing one person to giving public notice of goods, and newspapers made this the dominant use.
items.cn: 词义从告知某个人，转为公开告知商品信息；报纸让这一用法成为主流。

items.en: The commercial sense is now the main one; advertisement was formed from the verb with -ment, and British speech clips it to advert.
items.cn: 商业义如今是主要义项；advertisement 由这个动词加 -ment 构成，英式口语又把它截短为 advert。

note.en: The look-alike group is the word's own family; the near-meaning group gathers verbs for promoting, publicizing and pushing a product.
note.cn: 形近组是这个词自己的词族；近义组收表示推广、宣传与推销的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for a public notice that promotes something; formed from the verb with -ment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「广告」，指推广某事物的公开告示，由本词加 -ment 构成。

entries.definition: The person or company that pays for an advertisement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「广告主、登广告者」，由本词加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: The business or activity of promoting goods and services.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「广告业、广告活动」，由本词加 -ing 构成。

entries.definition: A British informal clipping of advertisement, not of the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「广告」，是 advertisement 的英式口语截短形式，并非直接由动词截成。

entries.definition: To help sell or make popular a product or event, often through campaigns.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「推广、促销」，常通过活动让商品或活动更好卖、更受欢迎。

entries.definition: To make something widely known, whether or not it is for sale.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「宣传、公布」，只强调让公众知道，不一定是卖东西。

entries.definition: To plan how a product is sold and presented, a broader business activity than placing ads.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「营销、推销」，比投放广告范围更广，包含销售与呈现的整体规划。

entries.definition: To mention a product or show in order to help it, as a guest might on air.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「（在节目里）顺带宣传」，如嘉宾在播出中提及自己的作品。

entries.definition: To try hard to sell or praise something, often in a way people distrust.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「兜售、吹捧」，常带有令人不信任的意味。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb advertere and the older sense of informing, which the modern selling sense grew out of.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁动词 advertere，以及现代「推销」义所由来的「告知」旧义。

normal.en: Advertere is 'to turn toward', so advertising turns a crowd's eyes toward a product.
normal.cn: advertere 是「使转向」，所以 advertising 就是把一群人的眼睛转向商品。

normal.en: The earliest English sense was simply 'to inform', and advertising still starts with making something known.
normal.cn: 英语最早的义项只是「告知」，而广告至今仍从「让人知道」开始。

normal.en: Advertisement came later from advertise with -ment, so the verb is the older English word.
normal.cn: advertisement 是后来由 advertise 加 -ment 构成的，所以动词才是更早的英语词。

normal.en: To advertise for a waiter is to hold up a notice that asks, not one that praises.
normal.cn: advertise for a waiter 举起的是一张「求人」的告示，而不是夸赞的告示。

normal.en: A careless remark can advertise your mistake, because the word means making something public, not only selling.
normal.cn: 一句不慎的话就能 advertise 你的错误，因为这个词的意思是「使公开」，不只是「卖东西」。

abstract.en: Picture a plate lifted above a crowd and turned slowly so that everyone can read it.
abstract.cn: 想象一块牌子被举到人群头顶，慢慢转动，让每个人都能读到。

abstract.en: Advertising does not make a thing better; it only makes it seen.
abstract.cn: 广告不会让东西变好，它只是让东西被看见。

abstract.en: The same raised sign can sell soap, ask for a worker, or expose a fault; only the message changes.
abstract.cn: 同一块举起的牌子可以卖肥皂、招工人，也可以暴露缺点，变的只是牌子上写的内容。

examples.en: The company advertised its new phone on television.
examples.cn: 公司在电视上为新手机会做广告。

examples.en: The bakery advertised for an assistant in its window.
examples.cn: 面包店在橱窗里登广告招一名帮手。

examples.en: The event was advertised as a family day.
examples.cn: 这场活动被宣传为家庭日。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿德外台兹」——阿德把牌子举过头顶，一圈人都抬头看：做广告。

root: 拉丁语 advertere「使转向」，由 ad-「朝向」+ vertere「转」构成；英语先有动词 advertise「使人注意、告知」，商业上的「做广告」义是后来从「公开告知」发展出来的。

sensesIntro.en: All six senses turn something toward an audience: a product, a vacancy, a request, a private fault, a conspicuous feature, or a chosen label.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项都是把某样东西转向受众：商品、职位空缺、请求、私下的过失、显眼的特征，或一个挑好的名目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sign is lifted above a crowd and turned so that every face follows it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块牌子被举到人群上方并转动，每张脸都跟着转过去。

branches.en: THE MARKET: paid space and time turn an audience toward goods.
branches.cn: 市场线：付费买下的版面与时段把观众转向商品。

branches.en: THE NOTICE BOARD: a job or a request is posted where the right people will see it.
branches.cn: 告示牌线：职位或请求被贴到合适的人能看见的地方。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC CONFESSION: whatever is shown to the crowd can also expose the one who showed it.
branches.cn: 公开线：凡是展示给人群的东西，也可能反过来暴露展示它的人。

branches.en: THE SPOTLIGHT: a bright colour or mark draws the eye without any notice being bought.
branches.cn: 聚光线：鲜艳的颜色或标记不用花钱登告示就能把目光拉过来。

branches.en: THE LABEL: to advertise as is to choose the words in which the public will first see a thing.
branches.cn: 标签线：be advertised as 就是替公众挑好第一眼看到它时用的说法。

intro.en: Advertise joins the Latin prefix ad- to the turning verb vertere; English endings then build the whole advertising family.
intro.cn: advertise 把拉丁语前缀 ad- 与表示「转」的动词 vertere 结合在一起；英语词尾随后构成整个广告词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere and advertere are recorded; the modern commercial sense has no Latin equivalent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere 与 advertere 都有记录；现代的商业义在拉丁语里并没有对应义项。

items.example: It joins vertere to form advertere.
items.exampleCN: 它与 vertere 结合构成 advertere。

items.example: The same root appears in convert and reverse.
items.exampleCN: 同一词根还出现在 convert 与 reverse 里。

items.example: The English verb comes from this form.
items.exampleCN: 英语的动词来自这个形式。

items.example: It carries the Latin verb into English as advertise.
items.exampleCN: 它把拉丁动词带入英语，成为 advertise。

items.meaning: a person or thing that does
an activity or an action in progress
items.meaningCN: 活动，或正在进行的动作

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「广告」
由本词加表施动者的后缀 -er 构成，义为「广告主」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「广告业；广告活动」

definition_zh: 文学；文学作品；文献；资料；宣传印刷品
definition_en: written works such as novels, poems and plays that are valued as art, the books and articles written about a subject, or printed material used to promote something
core_image: 书架上按国别排开的一排小说，书脊颜色深浅不一
scene: 图书馆的旧书区里，一排小说按国别排开，书脊被摸得发亮。 She studied English literature at university and later taught it to teenagers.
sceneCN: 这里 literature 是「文学」（第 1 个义项：作为艺术的小说、诗歌与戏剧）；句意为她在大学学习英国文学，后来教青少年。图中可辨识物件：旧书架、按国别排列的小说、发亮的书脊。

pos.zh: 文学；文献；资料；宣传印刷品

derivatives.zh: 与 literature 同出拉丁语 litteratura，义为「文学的；书面的」
由同一词干加 -ate 构成，义为「有读写能力的」
由同一词干加 -cy 构成，义为「读写能力」

senses.title: Written works valued as art
senses.definition: novels, poems, plays and other writing valued for form and imagination rather than for information alone
senses.definitionCN: 小说、诗歌、戏剧等因其形式与想象力而受重视、而非只用来传递信息的写作
senses.example: She studied English literature at university.
senses.exampleCN: 她在大学学习英国文学。
senses.why: Litteratura first meant the act of writing and the learning that letters bring; the works carrying that learning took the name, and artistic writing moved to the centre.
senses.whyCN: litteratura 最初指书写这件事以及文字带来的学问；承载这种学问的作品接过了这个名字，艺术性的写作后来占据了中心。

senses.title: The body of writing on a subject
senses.definition: the books, articles and reports published about a particular subject, considered as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一主题已出版的书籍、文章与报告的整体
senses.example: The literature on climate change is now enormous.
senses.exampleCN: 关于气候变化的文献现在多得惊人。
senses.why: A subject keeps its knowledge in texts; once those texts pile up, scholars call the whole shelf the literature of the field, even when the writing is technical.
senses.whyCN: 一个学科把知识存放在文本里；文本一旦堆积起来，学者就把整排书架称作该领域的文献，即便那些文字是技术性的。

senses.title: The academic study of literary works
senses.definition: the subject taught and researched at universities that deals with novels, poems and plays
senses.definitionCN: 大学里讲授与研究小说、诗歌、戏剧的学科
senses.example: He teaches literature at a small college.
senses.exampleCN: 他在一所小学规模的学院教文学。
senses.why: A body of texts large enough to be taught turns into a subject; the noun for the works becomes the noun for the department that studies them.
senses.whyCN: 一批文本大到可以被讲授时，就变成了一个学科；指作品的名词于是也用来指研究这些作品的院系。

senses.title: Printed material used for promotion
senses.definition: leaflets, brochures and other printed matter used to advertise or explain something
senses.definitionCN: 用来宣传或说明某事的传单、小册子等印刷品
senses.example: The clinic sent promotional literature to every household.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所给每户人家都寄了宣传资料。
senses.why: Print carries authority, so advertisers borrowed the word for their brochures; a leaflet inherits the seriousness of a book even when it is selling soap.
senses.whyCN: 印刷品自带权威感，于是广告商借这个词来指自己的小册子；一张传单即便在推销肥皂，也继承了书本的严肃。

intro.en: Literature comes from a Latin word for writing and learning, and only later narrowed towards novels, poems and plays.
intro.cn: literature 来自拉丁语中表示书写与学问的词，后来才收窄到指小说、诗歌与戏剧。

items.en: Littera meant a letter of the alphabet, and the plural litterae often meant a written document or a letter sent to someone.
items.cn: littera 指字母表中的一个字母，复数 litterae 常指文书或寄给人的书信。

items.en: Litteratura named writing and the learning gained from letters, but not yet a shelf of novels.
items.cn: litteratura 指书写活动以及由文字得来的学问，那时还不指一整架小说。

items.en: Old French took the word as literature, still meaning learning and written culture rather than fiction.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词写作 literature，仍指学问与书面文化，而不是虚构故事。

items.en: Early English used literature for polite learning and scholarship; the modern sense of imaginative writing developed slowly.
items.cn: 早期英语用 literature 指文雅的学问与学术；指想象性写作的现代义项是慢慢发展出来的。

items.en: Modern English centres literature on novels, poems and plays, while keeping the older sense for the body of writing on any subject.
items.cn: 现代英语把 literature 的中心放在小说、诗歌与戏剧，同时保留较旧的义项，指任何主题的文献整体。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the Latin stem of letters and writing; the near-meaning group gathers words for stories, poems and written work.
note.cn: 形近组沿着拉丁语中「字母、书写」的词干展开；近义组收表示故事、诗歌与文字作品的词。

entries.definition: Relating to literature or to formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 文学的；书面的；由同一拉丁词干构成。

entries.definition: Able to read and write.
entries.definitionCN: 有读写能力的；来自同一词干。

entries.definition: The ability to read and write.
entries.definitionCN: 读写能力；由同一词干加 -cy 构成。

entries.definition: A written symbol, or a message sent on paper.
entries.definitionCN: 字母；书信；经古法语进入英语，源自拉丁语 littera。

entries.definition: Stories and novels about imagined events.
entries.definitionCN: 虚构作品；讲述想象事件的故事与小说。

entries.definition: Poems as a form of literature.
entries.definitionCN: 诗歌；作为一种文学形式的诗。

entries.definition: Books, articles and other written work.
entries.definitionCN: 著作；文章等书面作品。

entries.definition: Serious academic study and the work it produces.
entries.definitionCN: 学术研究；认真治学及其成果。

normalIntro.en: The word grows out of the Latin word for a letter, and its family keeps returning to reading, learning and the works that carry both.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词从拉丁语中表示「字母」的词生长出来，同族词反复回到阅读、学问以及承载二者的作品。

normal.en: Littera is a letter and litteratura is writing made of letters, so literature began as the product of the alphabet.
normal.cn: littera 是字母，litteratura 是由字母写成的文字，所以 literature 最初就是字母的产物。

normal.en: Literature first meant learning gained from books, which is why a literature review still means reading what others have written.
normal.cn: literature 最初指从书本得来的学问，所以文献综述至今仍指阅读别人已经写下的东西。

normal.en: Literary is the adjective and literature the noun: one describes, the other names the whole body of works.
normal.cn: literary 是形容词，literature 是名词：一个作描述，一个指整批作品。

normal.en: A field's literature is the shelf of everything written about it, which is why doctors speak of the literature on a drug.
normal.cn: 一个领域的 literature 就是关于它的全部书面材料，所以医生会说某种药的文献。

normal.en: Promotional literature borrows the prestige of books for leaflets, because print still looks authoritative.
normal.cn: 宣传资料借用了书本的声望来指传单，因为印刷品至今看起来仍然权威。

abstract.en: A library is many voices stored as letters, and literature is the name for that chorus.
abstract.cn: 图书馆是许多声音被存成字母，literature 就是这支合唱的名字。

abstract.en: The same word covers a tragedy and a clinic brochure, because both are printed and meant to be read.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指一部悲剧，也指诊所的小册子，因为两者都是印出来供人阅读的。

abstract.en: Literature is what a culture chooses to keep reading, and that choice changes with each generation.
abstract.cn: 文学是一个文化选择继续阅读的东西，而这个选择会随每一代人改变。

examples.en: She studied English literature at university.
examples.cn: 她在大学学习英国文学。

examples.en: The literature on climate change is now enormous.
examples.cn: 关于气候变化的文献现在多得惊人。

examples.en: The clinic sent promotional literature to every household.
examples.cn: 诊所给每户人家都寄了宣传资料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「里头有扯」——书里头有扯不完的故事和道理，literature 就是文学、文献。

root: 拉丁语 littera（字母）→ litteratura（文字写作、由读书得来的学问）→ 古法语 literature → 英语 literature；同族词多与文字、读写、文学有关。

sensesIntro.en: The core is letters arranged into works; the senses divide into art writing, the body of texts on a subject, the academic field, and printed promotion.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是把字母排成作品；义项由此分出艺术性的写作、某主题的文本整体、学术学科，以及印刷宣传品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shelf of novels arranged by country, their spines worn bright by handling.
core.cn: 核心意象：书架上按国别排开的一排小说，书脊被翻摸得发亮。

branches.en: a shelf of novels ordered by country
branches.cn: 按国别排列的一架小说

branches.en: a seminar room where a poem is taken apart line by line
branches.cn: 研讨室里逐行拆解一首诗

branches.en: a researcher buried in journals about one drug
branches.cn: 研究者埋首于同一种药的期刊

branches.en: a waiting room table stacked with brochures
branches.cn: 候诊室桌上堆着宣传册

branches.en: a lecture hall listening to a reading of a play
branches.cn: 讲堂里听人朗读一出戏

intro.en: A Latin word for a letter, a Latin noun for writing, one French reshaping and four English forms carry literature from the alphabet to the shelf and the clinic.
intro.cn: 一个表示字母的拉丁词、一个表示书写的拉丁名词、一次法语改写，再加四个英语形式，把 literature 从字母表带到书架与诊所。

latinIntro.en: Littera, litteratura and litterarius are recorded Latin words; only litteratura is the direct source of literature.
latinIntro.cn: littera、litteratura 与 litterarius 都是有记录的拉丁词；其中只有 litteratura 是 literature 的直接来源。

items.meaningCN: 文字写作；由文字得来的学问

items.meaning: the ability to read and write
forming nouns of action or result
items.meaningCN: 构成表示行为或结果的名词后缀

latinEntries.meaningCN: 文字写作；由文字得来的学问

definition_en: to live permanently somewhere, to end an argument or problem, to make oneself comfortable, or to sink slowly
core_image: 行李放在新家的地板上，窗外的路终于不再延伸
scene: 他们在一个小镇定居下来。 They settled in a small town.
sceneCN: 这里 settle 是「定居」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他们在一个小镇定居下来。

derivatives.zh: 定居点；协议
定居者
稳定的；安定的
不安定的

senses.title: To live permanently
senses.definition: to go and live permanently in a place
senses.definitionCN: 到某地永久居住下来
senses.example: They settled in a small town.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在一个小镇定居下来。
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代主要义项。

senses.title: To resolve
senses.definition: to end an argument or solve a problem
senses.definitionCN: 结束争论或解决问题
senses.example: The two sides settled the dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 双方解决了争端。
senses.why: A matter comes to rest.
senses.whyCN: 事情落定下来。

senses.title: To get comfortable
senses.definition: to make oneself comfortable in a place
senses.definitionCN: 在某处安顿舒服
senses.example: She settled into the chair.
senses.exampleCN: 她在椅子上安顿下来。
senses.why: The body finds its place.
senses.whyCN: 身体找到自己的位置。

senses.title: To sink down
senses.definition: to sink slowly to the bottom or onto a surface
senses.definitionCN: 慢慢沉到底部或落在表面
senses.example: The dust settled on the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 灰尘落在架子上。
senses.why: Even particles come to rest.
senses.whyCN: 连微粒也会落定。

intro.en: Settle comes from Old English setlan, to seat, from setl, a seat.
intro.cn: settle 源自古英语 setlan（使就座），来自 setl（座位）。

items.en: Setl meant a seat.
items.cn: setl 意为座位。

items.en: Setlan meant to seat or place.
items.cn: setlan 意为使就座、安放。

items.en: Settle meant to come to rest.
items.cn: settle 意为落定、安定。

items.en: Settle named permanent residence.
items.cn: settle 指定居。

items.en: Settle extended to disputes and debts.
items.cn: settle 扩展到解决争端与清偿债务。

note.en: Settle is compared with similar-looking words and with words for resolving and residing.
note.cn: 把 settle 与形近词以及表示解决和居住的词作比较。

entries.definition: to place
entries.definitionCN: 放置

entries.definition: a person who settles
entries.definitionCN: 定居者

entries.definition: a place to sit
entries.definitionCN: 座位

entries.definition: to live somewhere
entries.definitionCN: 居住

entries.definition: to solve a problem
entries.definitionCN: 解决

entries.definition: to go down slowly
entries.definitionCN: 下沉

normalIntro.en: Settle is the body, the argument, and the dust all finding a place to rest.
normalIntro.cn: settle 是身体、争论与灰尘都找到地方安歇。

normal.en: They settled near the river.
normal.cn: 他们在河边定居。

normal.en: The quarrel was settled quickly.
normal.cn: 争吵很快平息了。

normal.en: She settled into a warm chair.
normal.cn: 她在温暖的椅子上安顿下来。

normal.en: Snow settled on the roof.
normal.cn: 雪落在屋顶上。

normal.en: The bill was settled by card.
normal.cn: 账单用卡结清了。

abstract.en: To settle is to stop moving long enough to belong.
abstract.cn: 安顿下来，就是停得够久，从而有所归属。

abstract.en: Some arguments end not by winning but by resting.
abstract.cn: 有些争论不是赢出来的，而是停下来才结束的。

abstract.en: Everything heavy eventually finds the ground.
abstract.cn: 沉重之物终会找到地面。

examples.en: They settled in a small town.
examples.cn: 他们在一个小镇定居下来。

examples.en: The two sides settled the dispute.
examples.cn: 双方解决了争端。

examples.en: The dust settled on the shelf.
examples.cn: 灰尘落在架子上。

dict_mnemonic.text: settle 源自古英语 setlan（使就座），核心义「坐下来、安定」，引申出定居、解决与沉降。

root: 源自古英语 setl（座位）与 setlan（使就座），核心义「安放到座位上」。

sensesIntro.en: Settle means to live somewhere, resolve a problem, get comfortable, or sink down.
sensesIntro.cn: settle 意为定居、解决、安顿或沉降。

core.en: Coming to rest in a place or a condition.
core.cn: 在某个位置或状态中安定下来。

branches.en: Staying in one place.
branches.cn: 留在一个地方。

branches.en: Bringing a dispute to rest.
branches.cn: 让争端平息。

branches.en: The body finding comfort.
branches.cn: 身体找到舒适的位置。

branches.en: Particles coming to the bottom.
branches.cn: 微粒落到底部。

branches.en: Home and comfort share one verb.
branches.cn: 安家与安适共用一个动词。

intro.en: Settle grows from the old seat word setl and its suffix -le.
intro.cn: settle 从古老的「座位」词 setl 加后缀 -le 生长而来。

latinIntro.en: Settle has no Latin ancestor; Latin sedere, to sit, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: settle 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 sedere（坐）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The bird settled on the branch.

items.meaning: the act of coming to rest
items.example: The settling of the soil took months.
items.exampleCN: 土壤的沉降花了几个月。

items.example: The first settlers built a bridge.
items.exampleCN: 最早的定居者建了一座桥。

items.example: The family resettled in the north.
items.exampleCN: 这家人重新在北方定居。
